sentences.text:
For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sunil Kumar Verma, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Government Pleader (26)
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order

2. The petitioners by invoking the extra ordinary jurisdiction of this Court under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking a declaration that the land acquisition proceeding vide Case No. 01 of 2013-14, which relates to Power Grid Sub-station Construction by the Bihar State Power Transmission Company Ltd., Patna in the district of Sheohar, to have lapsed by virtue of operation of Section-24(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in view of the Award under Section-11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 not having been prepared till 31.12.2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned Advocate for the petitioners contended that for construction of Power Grid Sub-station Construction by the Bihar State Power Transmission Company Ltd, in the district of Sheohar, a notification was issued on 23.08.2013 by the Patna High Court CWJC No.15395 of 2024(2)
dt.08-10-2024 Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Bihar.

entities.text: Bihar State Power Transmission Company Ltd
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Further, subsequent to a declaration, in terms of Section 6 of the 1894 Act on 27.08.2013, a notification was also published in the daily newspaper on 15.09.2013.

It is the case of the petitioners that despite the aforesaid fact,
award has not been prepared, till coming into force of the New Act, 2013 and, as such, the case of the petitioners shall be governed under Section 24(1)(a) of the Act, 2013 and the petitioners must be compensated in terms thereof.
